comment: THIRD REVIEW 2026-10-22 item 2 (reviewer repro remand_seq): `cast=Ponder;cast=Remand` with its "**" sequence. Remand has no action of its own -- it rides on the cast it counters (Action::remand_by) -- so the `cast=Remand` step matched nothing and the line was Illegal. The step now claims the rider; it resolves where it really does, with Ponder's cast. (Same rider in Hinata2, NivMizzetCombo, Unpredictable Cyclone.)
